title: Prevent premature cancellation of in-flight Paper/Live-shadow FAK orders
author: agent:/root

originalRequests.text: Почему были Cancelled две живые ставки стратегии ETH 5m 1 Diff Confirmed Average Premarket LossDiff 4+ ?

scope.goal: Correct the confirmed Paper/Live-shadow FAK expiry race so an in-flight Live intent is not immediately cancelled before its linked decision deadline and its placement result can be persisted normally.
inScope: The shared `paper_live_shadow_test` FAK intent creation path used by exact strategy b7c50005-0000-4000-8225-000000000004 / eth_up_down_5m_1_diff_confirmed_average_premarket_lossdiff_4_plus and the other current callers of the same method.
Use the already persisted linked Paper order expiry, which is the decision cancel deadline, as the Live intent expiry instead of the intent creation timestamp.
Focused regression coverage for the exact LossDiff Paper-parent/Live-child path and for Live maintenance while a Paper/Live-shadow intent has a future expiry and no venue order id yet.

Repository requirement evidence, context/history bookkeeping, independent semantic review, task-only product commit, and push to the configured upstream after verification while preserving pre-existing unrelated working-tree changes.
outOfScope: Changing strategy signals, LossDiff state or threshold logic, selected outcome, price, size, notional, FAK order semantics, risk controls, balances, Live enablement, or market-window calculation.

Changing cancellation behavior at or after the existing linked decision deadline, kill-switch cancellation, explicit pause cancellation, venue response classification, fill accounting, or Paper/Live parity semantics.
Changing non-`paper_live_shadow_test` Live order creation or lifecycle paths, schema, migrations, catalog identities, Dashboard, README, or architecture documentation.
Deploying or restarting the service, placing or cancelling an actual venue order, or mutating Local/Production databases, strategies, orders, balances, or configuration.

Including or modifying the pre-existing unrelated working-tree changes in README.md, src/PolyCopyTrader.Domain/StrategyDisplayCategories.cs, or tests/PolyCopyTrader.Tests/StrategyDisplayCategoryTests.cs.
scope.periodOrFilter: Future `paper_live_shadow_test` FAK intents after user deployment; existing orders and historical records remain unchanged.
scope.firstVerification: Inspect the exact Live-shadow intent construction, all callers, linked Paper/decision expiry values, Live maintenance cancellation predicate, row-version persistence path, and existing focused tests before editing.

requirements.text: Persist each affected Paper/Live-shadow FAK Live intent with the same existing cancel deadline as its linked Paper order and shadow decision, not with its creation timestamp.
requirements.sourceQuote: ETH 5m 1 Diff Confirmed Average Premarket LossDiff 4+
acceptanceCriteria: For the exact LossDiff 4+ Paper-parent/Live-child flow, the Live intent exists before the venue call returns and its ExpiresAtUtc exactly equals the linked Paper order ExpiresAtUtc and decision CancelDeadlineUtc.
When the linked cancel deadline is later than creation, the Live intent ExpiresAtUtc is also later than CreatedAtUtc; the previous ExpiresAtUtc=CreatedAtUtc defect is absent.
Every current caller of the shared `TryPlacePaperLiveShadowOrderAsync` method receives the same correction through the linked Paper order without strategy-specific branching or a new deadline policy.

verification.expected: Both exact LossDiff reset/positive cases pass and observe the in-flight Live intent using the linked Paper/decision cancel deadline before placement returns.

requirements.text: Keep an unexpired Paper/Live-shadow intent with no venue order id open during maintenance, while preserving existing cancellation once its linked deadline is reached.
acceptanceCriteria: Before ExpiresAtUtc, Live maintenance sends neither cancel-all nor a specific cancel for a Submitted `paper_live_shadow_test` intent whose venue order id is not yet available, and does not change the intent to Cancelled.
The existing `now >= ExpiresAtUtc` cancellation rule remains unchanged, including the existing safety behavior after the linked deadline and kill-switch/pause behavior.
The focused regression reproduces the vulnerable in-flight state without external venue or database access.

verification.expected: The future-expiry/no-order-id intent remains Submitted and zero cancel-all or specific-cancel calls occur.

requirements.text: Make no trading-policy or Production-state change beyond the confirmed expiry correction and verify the bounded implementation before delivery.
acceptanceCriteria: The frozen ExecutionIntent, strategy selection, LossDiff gates, FAK request, preflight/risk checks, venue result handling, Paper reconciliation, and cancellation rule at/after deadline remain unchanged.
No Production/Local database, service, deployment, strategy setting, order, wallet, balance, or configuration is mutated.
